verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents incremental sync as pulling only data changed since the previous sync, alongside configurable sync modes. Its CDC docs describe Airbyte tracking its current position in database logs to capture inserts, updates and deletes. A community user reports that once the initial sync was marked done, Airbyte 'continued to sync happily', which corroborates ongoing incremental state handling. Missing for 10: explicit evidence on how cursor fields and state are persisted and managed automatically outside the Connector Builder context, clarity on hard-delete handling in cursor-based incremental mode (raised as an open community question), and stronger independent hands-on corroboration.
